title: Reindexing a fixed sign cube
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and $J$ a set of coordinates in $ br^n$ represented by a finite subset of $ br^n$. The space of sign assignments to the coordinates outside $J$ is bijective to the space of sign vectors of length equal to the number of those remaining coordinates, by reindexing the coordinates.
hypotheses_covered: A finite set $J$ of coordinates in $ br^n$
